<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="mission">

      <!-- Navigate to vending_machine with reactive person-detection interrupt -->
      <!-- On detection: stop nav, wait for person to leave, wait 10s, resume -->
      <RetryUntilSuccessful num_attempts="100" name="nav_to_vending_machine">
        <Sequence name="nav_attempt">

          <!-- Pre-check: if a person is currently detected, wait for them to leave then wait 10s -->
          <ForceSuccess name="handle_person_if_present">
            <Sequence name="person_handling">
              <!-- Only enters if person is currently seen -->
              <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_person_present"/>
              <!-- Wait until person leaves (CheckDetection drops to FAILURE) -->
              <ReactiveFallback name="wait_until_person_gone">
                <Inverter>
                  <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_person_gone"/>
                </Inverter>
                <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                  <Wait wait_duration="1.0" name="polling_wait"/>
                </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
              </ReactiveFallback>
              <!-- Wait an additional 10 seconds after person has left -->
              <Wait wait_duration="10.0" name="wait_10_seconds"/>
            </Sequence>
          </ForceSuccess>

          <!-- Navigate to vending_machine; halt immediately if person detected -->
          <ReactiveSequence name="guarded_nav">
            <!-- Guard: succeeds only when NO person is detected -->
            <Inverter>
              <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_no_person"/>
            </Inverter>
            <NavigateToLocation location="vending_machine" name="go_to_vending_machine"/>
          </ReactiveSequence>

        </Sequence>
      </RetryUntilSuccessful>

      <!-- Return to [lab] entrance after reaching vending machine -->
      <NavigateToLocation location="[lab]_entrance" name="return_to_[lab]"/>

    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_[lab]_entrance" location="[lab]_entrance"/>

        <Fallback name="detect_person">

          <WaitForDetection name="wait_for_person_60s" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" timeout="60.0"/>

          <ReactiveFallback name="sweep_until_person">

        <ForceSuccess>
